This legacy code names propane-1,2-diol, regulated as E1520 in the EU; identity was checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Propane-1,2-diol is the chemical also known as propylene glycol. It is used as a carrier or solvent for specified food ingredients.
more_info.origin: A synthetic glycol made by chemical processing; the CFR describes manufacture from propylene chlorohydrin or from glycerol.
